name: Miyamoto Ken
source:
"Miyamoto Prefecture" is an educational game on earthquakes. A virtual experience of going 
through post-earthquake life from the occurrence of an earthquake to the breakdown of infrastructures.

Technically fiction but based on real experiences.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE232560.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《宫本县》是一款关于地震的教育游戏。虚拟的出行体验 
从地震发生到基础设施崩溃的震后生活。

技术上是虚构的，但基于真实的经历。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE232560.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
